events.name: Cursor Mini Summer Hackathon Helsinki
events.description: An afternoon of building with Cursor: team up, build an AI-assisted project, and show a mini demo. Terrace hangs, food and drinks. All skill levels welcome; local Cursor ambassador Mari Luukkainen helps on site. Event full — waitlist open.

events.name: Helsinki Tech Mixer and Social (Tech / AI / Data / IT)
events.description: Weekly Friday afterwork mixer for tech, AI, data and IT professionals, startup employees and entrepreneurs. Casual networking, job leads and trend talk over drinks.

events.name: Founders Running Club :: Helsinki
events.description: Weekly easy run + networking for founders, investors and startup people, finishing with coffee and conversations. Part of a global 65+ city community; ~110 registered in Helsinki.

events.name: AI Solution Sprint
events.description: Two-day sprint at Maria 01 solving real-life AI challenges from companies together with Business Helsinki, Metropolia, Haaga-Helia and AI Start.

events.name: FiBAN Academy 1/3 – Getting Started With Angel Investing
events.description: First part of FiBAN's three-part academy on angel investing fundamentals — useful both for aspiring angels and founders who want to understand how angels think.

events.name: Maria 01 NEXT Startup Festival & Afterparty
events.description: Two-day startup festival from one of Europe's leading startup communities: the ideas, companies and people shaping what's next, wrapped up with an afterparty. Built by the community, open to the world.

events.name: VERGE | Deep Tech: Beyond the Screen. Into the Bedrock.
events.description: Deep tech conference at Epicenter Helsinki exploring what's next beyond software — for founders, investors and corporates interested in frontier technology.
